This is a construction, not a claim about history. It asks whether a single coupled relaxation — a flood, a glaciation, and an Atlantic-opening, all driven by one release of a jammed deep-water reservoir — is physically permitted by measured constants and the VP jamming engine. It never asserts the sequence occurred: every past-occurrence statement is capped at [O], both directions.

## Shared-infrastructure concept cards

Every term this volume uses (inherited) or owns is carded here once, linked to its canonical definition in /concepts/ and, for inherited modules, /common_modules/. Grades are the standing grades from the registry.

### Owned by this volume

Dual-redox petroleum mechanism 6/6 provinces — Glacial meltwater does opposite things to oxygen at two depths: sealing it out deep (preserving source rock) and bringing it in shallow (making oil heavy); reproduces oil quality across 6/6 provinces (M42). [V] · concept

Freshwater-lid anoxia present-tense — A layer of fresh meltwater sitting on heavier seawater stops oxygen reaching the bottom → the bottom goes anoxic → organic matter is preserved (the source-rock preservation half of the dual-redox). [V] · concept

S0 deep-water reservoir release SH-5 [O] — The single load-bearing release that drives the coupled cascade; the deep-water inventory is bounded present-tense and exceeds the largest requirement by ~10× [V] (M50), but the releasable fraction and mechanism stay open [O]. [O] · concept

Magnitude-ratio discriminator SH-26 [O] — The one genuinely-discriminating cross-system test; the protocol harness and canonical population are built (M49) but the decisive run stays open pending verified source volumes — no fabrication. [O] · concept

Integrative tuning-free causal closure 8:1 [L] — One untuned cause closes nine present-tense phenomena of the cascade with zero data-fitted parameters, where the mainstream uses eight independent mechanisms — an 8:1 compression in mechanism and parameter count (parsimony, not proof). [L] · concept

Present-tense deglaciation recency order 10⁴ yr [V] — Order 10⁴ yr read from ongoing rebound (~1 cm/yr) plus the measured mantle relaxation time, with no calendar date and no assumed rate; a present-tense observable that does NOT promote the cascade's occurrence past [O]. [V] · concept

Occurrence cap (chronology firewall) [O] [O] — Any claim that the coupled sequence (or any face) occurred in Earth history is capped at [O] (Art. 1.2), decided only by independent dating; the firewall is bidirectional — it withholds both 'deep time' and 'recent'. [O] · concept

### Inherited (used) from the VP spine

R19 bistable switch jammed ⇄ unjammed — One engine behind every step: a jammed (load-bearing) state that flips to unjammed (flowing); substrate S0, the rupture engine and the build/melt asymmetry are the same switch in different settings. [F] · concept

Elastic-wave speed of the vacuum lattice c² = B/ρ c² = B/ρ — The VP foundation relation (light speed as an elastic-wave speed of the jammed vacuum lattice); it is why the deep material can be solid yet flow. [F] · concept

Material-threshold scale (promoter stiffness) γ = −mean NN stacking ΔG₃₇ measured — Sets the R19 critical SCALE from measured nearest-neighbour stacking energy (SantaLucia); corr(γ,GC)≈0.998, measured and un-fitted. [V] · concept

Maxwell relaxation time τ_M τ_M = η/μ — The timescale that decides solid-vs-fluid response: the mantle carries S-waves over seconds yet convects over Myr; it sets the rebound clock used in M44. [F] · concept

Jamming–unjamming continental engine Ψ_eff > Ψ_y Ψ_eff > Ψ_y — Rapid continental break-up as a jamming→unjamming transition once the effective stress exceeds the yield surface; the inherited geodynamics engine the cascade re-runs (39/39 PASS). [F] · concept

Conservation identity (fixed-globe bookkeeping) ΔA_open = −ΔA_close exact — On a fixed-size globe, opening one ocean must be balanced by closing elsewhere — an exact bookkeeping identity that anchors the Continental-Genesis import (M45). [F] · concept

Glacial isostatic adjustment (forebulge / marine limit) GIA present-tense — Crust bending under ice and springing back after; the forebulge and marine limit record the former load, and ongoing uplift is the present-tense recency clock. [V] · concept

Stick-slip / duty cycle — Mostly-stuck motion with rare fast slips; a slow average speed can be rare fast events spread thinly, so a present speed cannot by itself date onset. [F] · concept

Biodegradation < ~80 °C — Microbes eat the light fractions of oil in cool, shallow, oxygen-reached reservoirs, leaving it heavy; the process shuts off above ~80 °C. [V] · concept

Source rock anoxic — Organic-rich rock that later generates oil; it needs a quiet, oxygen-starved (anoxic) setting to preserve the organic matter. [V] · concept

Double-SHA-256 gate 2×sha256 pinned — A self-check inside each script: it hashes its own output twice and refuses to pass unless the hash matches the pinned value — proof the result has not drifted. [V] · concept

Fixed seed convention SEED = 19 19 — The fixed random-seed convention so every load-bearing computation is deterministic and reproducible. [V] · concept

# The VP Recent-Sequence Cascade

### A Coupled Flood → Glaciation → Atlantic-Opening Relaxation on a Jammed-Water Substrate — a physically-permitted, occurrence-open hypothesis

Author: Young Jae Lee · ORCID 0009-0002-7535-8245

License: CC BY 4.0 · Site: https://jamming-physics.org/

Inherits: VP physics foundation (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17932566) · Atlantic-opening geodynamics volume (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17978934)

Governance: VP-SPEC — no-tuning · LOCK→Derive→Gate · graded verdicts [F]/[V]/[L]/[O] · bidirectional chronology firewall · single-substrate (R19 bistable switch).

## How to read this document

This is a construction, not a claim about history. It asks one question:

Is a single coupled relaxation — a flood, a glaciation, and an ocean-opening, all driven by one release of a jammed deep-water reservoir — physically permitted by measured constants and the VP jamming engine?

It never asserts that such a sequence occurred. Under the governing constitution, every statement about a past occurrence is capped at grade [O] (open) in both directions: the document neither smuggles in "deep time" nor "recent," and absolute dates are held only as record, never as load-bearing premises. What can be graded [F] (forced/derived) or [V] (verified/measured/reproduced) is mechanism and present-tense measurement; [L] (leaning) marks a well-anchored inference; [O] marks what stays open.

Comparison to alternative geological frameworks (the "stress-test") is deliberately out of scope here and deferred to a later phase. This document builds the cascade on its own VP foundation and states honestly what it does and does not establish. [v30 update, mark-never-erase: that deferred phase has since been RUN as Module 52 (Tier-4) — the cascade survives as permitted/coherent but with zero present-tense discriminating advantage; every distinctive axis is degenerate or coherence-only, and the single vulnerability is localised to the S0 release (SH-5). Occurrence stays [O], both directions.]

v30 reframe (mark-never-erase): two corrections from the petroleum/glaciation strand refine the framing; the prior wording stands, these are appended.

(1) Coupling, not dating. The testable content is causal coupling (present-tense, falsifiable); absolute timing is held [O] by design. This renames the claim — it does not promote occurrence.

(2) Glaciation is the driver (flood secondary). The deglaciation recency (order 10⁴ yr) is present-tense [V] from ongoing rebound (M44). Firewall boundary: this is a present-tense observable about the ice — the cascade’s occurrence stays [O]; the flood/coupling absolute timing is not promoted.

Strand SSOT: Glaciation-Driven Petroleum overview (dual-redox core + 8-fingerprint scorecard).

The value criterion (read this): the past cannot be settled by any single present-tense discriminator — the firewall holds occurrence [O], and M37, M39 and M46 each came back degenerate. That is correct epistemics, not a weakness.

What actually distinguishes the frameworks: integrative, tuning-free causal closure. One conserved relaxation governed by the kernel closes nine present-tense phenomena with zero data-fitted parameters (a verifiable no-tuning gate), where the mainstream needs eight independent mechanisms — an 8:1 causal compression. See Module 47 (capstone).

Grade: causal closure is [L] (parsimony, not proof; occurrence stays [O]). When both frameworks fit the present and no discriminator separates them, the one untuned cause is the rational choice. Causality is the highest available value.

v30 finalization — lead reframe (mark-never-erase): the subtitle above ("a physically-permitted, occurrence-open hypothesis") stands, but the leading claim is now the one Module 47 isolates: not merely that the cascade is permitted, but that its distinguishing value is integrative, tuning-free causal closure — one untuned cause closing many present-tense phenomena where the mainstream uses many independent ones. Permission is the floor; causal closure is the thesis. Single source of truth for remaining tasks: OPEN_FRONTIER.html.

Rhetoric tightened to the grade: the phrases "the rational choice" and "the highest available value" above are parsimony language and must be read strictly as [L]: tuning-free causal closure is the strongest available distinguishing consideration, not a demonstration that the cascade occurred. It does not promote occurrence past [O], and a reader who prefers to withhold even the parsimony lean is within the framework's honest bounds.

On the 8:1 count (pre-empting the fair objection): the 8:1 is a compression in mechanism count and data-fitted-parameter count (zero tuned parameters vs many), not a probability or a likelihood ratio. It does not erase the cascade's empirical risk — it concentrates it: the single untuned cause still rests on one large open assumption, the S0 reservoir release (SH-5), which stays [O] (M50 bounds the inventory but not the release fraction). So the honest trade is "eight independent mechanisms" vs "one untuned mechanism + one [O] release" — a real parsimony gain in structure, with the whole risk localised to SH-5, not dissolved.

Present-tense discriminators, now six-fold degenerate: M34, M35, M37, M39, M46 and — added at v30 — the causal-ordering / superposition test M48 all return present-tense [V]-but-non-discriminating. The degeneracy is therefore structural (Module 20), which is precisely why the value criterion is causal closure rather than any single test. Kernel coherence across the corpus is made explicit in M51 ([L]).

## 1. The substrate: jammed State-4 water (S0)

The VP foundation treats the vacuum as a jammed elastic solid (rigid constituents at random close packing), from which the speed of light follows as the lattice elastic-wave speed, c² = B/ρ, and the proton radius and mass ratios follow as forced geometric results (m_p/m_e = 6π⁵, −19 ppm). On this medium, "soft" behaviour is the unjamming/relaxation of a load-bearing contact network — the R19 bistable switch (jammed ⇄ unjammed) is the universal engine.

The cascade's reservoir S0 is the geological instance of this engine: high-pressure "jammed" water — ice-VII / State-4 water — stored at depth. It is a loaded spring: a metastable, load-bearing high-pressure phase whose confinement can be released.

- Observed [V]. Ice-VII has been recovered as inclusions in natural diamonds, and hydrous ringwoodite likewise — direct evidence that water is stored as a high-pressure solid phase in the deep Earth.

- Identity with the engine's only admissible source. The Atlantic-opening volume audited where the energy of a rapid rupture could come from and found that the sole energetically admissible class is the release of a stored internal reservoir (≥10²⁶ J) — competing classes (super-plume heat generation; electromagnetic residual) fail by 1–6 orders. S0 is exactly that reservoir. The cascade therefore does not invent an energy source; it inherits a bounded one, whose remaining open question is the conversion efficiency and the reservoir's present-day geophysical signature.

Grade: substrate observed [V]; its role as the cascade's energy reservoir = the engine's H-E1 class, [F] by the inherited audit; the reservoir's release as a past event, [O].

## 2. The engine, inherited and verified: void-suction + unjamming

The mechanism that converts a reservoir release into rapid motion is inherited in full from the Atlantic-opening geodynamics volume, and every load-bearing quantity below was checked against that source and re-run in this environment (the volume's bundle reproduces 39/39 PASS, integrity 60/60 SHA-OK).

State picture (from the foundation's 4-3-1 state dictionary). A basal shear zone of granular gouge sits in State 4 (jammed: load-bearing backbone, finite yield stress σ_Y, solid-like) or State 3 (unjammed/liquefied: backbone dissolved, viscous flow). The control variable is the mean coordination number z relative to its isostatic value z_iso = 2d (= 6 in 3D); the jammed fraction is ξ ∈ [0,1].

The collapse (the yield gate). Shear heating drives z → z_iso; at isostaticity the relaxed shear modulus and the yield stress vanish (G_relaxed = 0.068·(z−z_iso) → 0; σ_Y → 0) while the bulk modulus stays finite. The load-bearing network dissolves before melting — liquefaction by unjamming, distinct from melt. Derived (no-tuning) constants: φ_jam = 0.840, z_iso = 6, G_Born ≈ 0.20 (finite). For a representative mid-crustal gouge the unjamming channel reaches μ_eff ≈ 2.2×10⁻³ at ΔT ≈ 25 K (no melting) — the melt-only counterfactual would need ΔT ≈ 1462 K, so unjamming reaches low friction at ~1.3% of the melt energy.

The void-suction drive. An antipodal rupture opens a pressure-deficit void whose suction (ΔP ~ 10⁸ Pa) does work on the unjammed (now low-friction) plate.

Three stresses, three roles — no contradiction. Three physically distinct stresses appear; they are not in conflict:

- ΔP ~ 10⁸ Pa — the suction deficit; an energy-input boundary condition (W_in = ΔP·A_eff·d).

- τ_res = μ_eff·σ_n ≈ 3×10⁵ Pa — the liquefied friction; the part dissipated as heat.

- τ_drive ~ 3–32 Pa — the mean-rate kinematic drive; the viscous stress merely to hold the slow mean rate against the liquefied viscosity (bookkeeping, not slip-burst resistance).

Motion mode = stick-slip (the natural mode is fast). A liquefied zone cannot creep slowly: the critical velocity exceeds cm/yr by ~10⁸ and the friction is velocity-weakening, so motion is stuck-or-fast. The cumulative actual sliding to open a 3000 km half-basin is ≈ 69 days at ~0.5 m/s; a slow apparent "spreading rate" is that brief slip packed sparsely (duty cycle ~10⁻⁹). A mm-thick shear band re-jams in τ = h²/κ ≈ 9 s, so each fast phase self-limits.

Bounds inherited. The mechanism passes all five Ω-NoGo limits (ΔR = 25 < 50 km; ΔP = 400 < 500 MPa; μ_eff = 2.2×10⁻³ ≤ 10⁻²; film h = 3 mm ≥ 1 µm; undrained at the macroscopic scale). It carries one honest HOLD (master-scale): μ_eff ≈ 0.002 requires pore pressure within ~0.4% of lithostatic, and the continental geometry does not laboratory-reproduce, so the continental claim rests on geometry-at-scale, registered open.

Grade: engine mechanism [F]/[V] (derived + reproduced); continental extrapolation [O]-HOLD; the event as history, [O].

## 3. One relaxation, one parameter, read three ways

The cascade's central economy: one destabilization, controlled by one parameter — the reservoir release mass M_r — presents as three coupled faces.

| Face
| What is released as
| One-parameter control

| H-F — Flood
| the reservoir water reaching the surface as a flood/inundation
| volume ∝ M_r

| H-G — Glaciation
| the released/redistributed water warming the ocean, then precipitating and accumulating as ice
| ocean-heat & moisture supply scale with the release

| H-A — Opening
| the void left by the collapsed enclosure driving rupture and ocean-opening
| void volume ∝ the collapsed reservoir

Flood, warm-ocean→glaciation, and rupture are not three independent events; they are one unjamming read three ways. This is the cascade's defining structural claim, and it makes sharp, falsifiable predictions (§7).

## 4. The observed coupled instance

The coupling is not only theoretical. One realised instance is observed and drilled:

- A deep canyon (the Eonile) is cut ~1.5 km below the present surface near Cairo and traced offshore — a flood-scale incision (H-F), present-tense geometry.

- It is filled by a thick evaporite (salt) sequence — a deep-water residue.

- The episode is gated by the Atlantic gateway: a desiccation when the gateway closed, then a refilling megaflood when it reopened (H-F ↔ H-A coupling).

This is an observed instance of flood-incision + salt residue + gateway/opening coupling — exactly the co-location the one-parameter picture predicts. (Absolute dates of the episode are held as record, not load-bearing.)

Grade: the coupled instance observed [F-perm] (flood + salt + gateway co-located, drilled); its generalisation to a global relaxation, [O].

## 5. The whole-chain energy ledger

Does the coupled chain close under one parameter, using only measured constants, without an absolute clock? The reproducible ledger (chain_energy_ledger.py) shows:

- The chain is energetically coherent. A few-percent release of the reservoir supplies the flood gravitational energy; the same warmed ocean supplies the moisture for one ice sheet; the void drives the opening. No step is energetically forbidden for one ice sheet. (Building all present-day ice in a single pulse remains an honest STOP — the chain does not claim that.)

- The heat is small and disposable. Of the input work (~3×10²⁶ J, dominated by the gravitational potential energy of opening the basin), only ~3% is friction heat (Chicxulub-class, not a planet-scale thermal pulse). Conduction alone cannot shed it, so advection by the lubricating fluid is forced — predicting a large, regionally pervasive, sub-melt hydrothermal signature (~10⁴–10⁶ km³ throughput). This is a testable prediction, not a hidden assumption.

- Build/melt asymmetry → rapid termination (the sawtooth). Building ice pays the (large) latent heat of vaporisation and is supply-limited (slow); melting pays only the (small) latent heat of fusion and is aided by restored warm circulation (fast). From these measured constants alone, the relaxation is predicted to be asymmetric: gradual build, abrupt termination — a sawtooth. The observed glacial record carries exactly this asymmetric shape. (Absolute durations are held as record; the prediction is the relative asymmetry.)

Grade: chain closure [F] (reproducible, chronology-free); build/melt asymmetry [F] from constants; the sawtooth match [L]; flood-energy sourcing = the demanding link, flagged open.

## 6. The cold coupling, and multiple evaporite pathways

A consilience the cascade inherits rather than assumes: the rupture engine prefers cold, thick lithosphere. The geodynamics feasibility window opens at detachment depths of ~12–26 km in cold cratons and narrows or closes under warm young crust — and a field test found detachment depth is thermally controlled (rank correlation with "coldness" = +1.00). The engine therefore sites itself where it is cold — and so couples naturally to the cold / glacial face of the relaxation.

This refines the evaporite/source-rock face into multiple pathways set by local setting:

- Cold / glacial restriction (high-latitude basins; cold-water indicators such as glendonites) — the cold flavour.

- Arid drawdown (warm rift basins; thick evaporites under an arid climate) — the warm flavour.

One engine, multiple regional expressions — a latitude-dependent picture, not a single forced mould. The decisive observational discriminator for the glacial face is ice-rafted debris / dropstones (not lamination texture, which is degenerate between warm and cold meltwater).

Grade: cold-thick-lithosphere siting [F] (inherited prediction, field-corroborated); multi-pathway evaporites [L]; the specific past flavour at any site, [O].

## 7. The cascade's falsifiable predictions

Because one parameter controls everything, the cascade predicts:

- P1 — Coupling co-location. Flood, opening/gateway, and (where cold) glacial signatures co-locate. (Observed instance: the Mediterranean/Eonile, §4.)

- P2 — Single asymmetric pulse. The relaxation is one asymmetric event (with internal depositional pulses), not a set of unrelated episodes.

- P3 — Build/melt asymmetry → rapid termination. A sawtooth, forced by latent-heat constants (§5). (Record shape consistent.)

- P4 — Material co-occurrence. Rift + evaporite (salt) + organic source rock co-occur. (Observed instance: South Atlantic pre-salt — syn-rift source rocks + a ≤2.5 km salt giant at the Atlantic opening.)

- P5 — Magnitude co-variation. The faces' magnitudes co-vary (one-parameter control): larger release ⇒ larger flood and larger glaciation and larger opening. (Suggestive: the South Atlantic salt giant tracks the maximum-extension segment; a clean magnitude/ratio test is specified but not yet run — the natural next experiment.)

Each prediction is graded on its own observational status above. Whether any prediction distinguishes this cascade from alternative frameworks is not assessed here — that is the deferred stress-test, now run as Module 52 (verdict: no distinctive axis discriminates present-tense).

## 8. Firewall and standing

The bidirectional chronology firewall. The inherited Atlantic-opening volume concedes the U–Pb break-up ages at full strength (the cascade does not contest them) and stays chronology-agnostic: the physics permits a rapid rupture phase if the bounded boundary conditions obtain, and the case is compatible with either timescale precisely so that independent geochronology — not any internal technicality — carries the decision. The cascade adopts this posture exactly. Absolute dates are record; occurrence is [O].

What is established. A unified, parsimonious, physically-permitted hypothesis: one substrate (jammed State-4 water = the engine's sole admissible reservoir), one parameter (release mass), one engine (void-suction + unjamming, verified and reproduced), presenting as a coupled flood + glaciation + opening, with a closing energy ledger, a forced build/melt asymmetry, a cold-lithosphere coupling, and five falsifiable predictions with one observed coupled instance.

What is not claimed. That the sequence occurred; any absolute timescale; or — within this document — any distinctiveness relative to alternative frameworks. Those are out of scope, by design.

The biology↔history bridge (integrated, Modules 22–24). This package now also carries the DNA Emergence whole and runnable (dna_emergence/), and a fossil-count audit (fossil_audit/). They reinforce the firewall from the biology side. The DNA work measures three present-tense facts in two kingdoms — material (γ) is a lineage property, the molecular clock is decoupled from the material, and the environment writes to STATE not material — and by those same facts shows that DNA is neutral on the occurrence: a small sequence difference is observed even across mainstream-large divergences, so it cannot date a quiet interval, cannot be promoted to flood evidence, and equally dissolves the "DNA proves deep time" reading. The fossil audit, recomputing raw counts from 179,689 real radiocarbon dates, confirms ancient remains are genuinely sparse [V] but shows the counts cannot attribute that sparseness to any cause [O]. Both route every occurrence/causation claim to independent geochronology and the history channel — exactly where the cascade's firewall already places it. And both are held to Article 7: every interpretation audited for being imported, every datum recomputed from source rather than recalled.

This whitepaper is a physically-permitted, occurrence-open construction with a reproducible spine — exactly the kind of object its governing constitution prescribes, and nothing more. Falsification = discovery (a refutation is a finding).

## 9. Reproducibility

Every load-bearing quantity reproduces from code or from a fetchable source; nothing is fitted. See REPRODUCIBILITY_MAP.md for the claim-by-claim map.

- Inherited engine bundle (inherited_engine/): 19 NumPy engines, SEED-fixed; validate_all.py → 39/39 PASS; SHA256SUMS.txt → 60/60 OK; mapped in LEDGER.md. (Full bundle incl. figures/results: DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17978934.)

- Cascade screens (repro/): c1_quant_screen.py (warm-ocean→glaciation rate NoGo screen), chain_energy_ledger.py (whole-chain closure + build/melt asymmetry).

- Foundation: DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17932566 (/physics/).

- DNA Emergence (inherited whole, runnable): dna_emergence/animal/ and dna_emergence/plant/ — each repro/run_all.py reproduces from frozen NCBI records, no network, no tuning (SantaLucia 1998 LOCK, SEED = 19); repro/fetch_ncbi.py re-fetches live. See dna_emergence/RUN_DNA_EMERGENCE.md. (Method DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20471407.)

- Fossil-count audit: fossil_audit/fossil_counts.py recomputes the counts from data/p3k14c_data.rda (179,689 real radiocarbon dates, Bird et al. 2022); raw counts [V], every cause [O].

- Governed record: the full per-step derivation, with grades and honest corrections, is in modules/ (Modules 12–24).

End of whitepaper. The detailed governed record (Modules 12–24), the reproducibility map, the cascade screens, the inherited engine bundle, the runnable DNA Emergence (animal + plant), and the fossil-count audit accompany this file in the package.

# VP Recent-Sequence Cascade — package README

A coupled Flood → Glaciation → Atlantic-Opening relaxation on a jammed-water substrate.

A physically-permitted, occurrence-open hypothesis, built on the VP jamming foundation and the Atlantic-opening geodynamics volume, with a fully reproducible spine.

- Author: Young Jae Lee · ORCID 0009-0002-7535-8245

- License: CC BY 4.0 · Site: https://jamming-physics.org/

- Foundations inherited: VP physics DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17932566 · Atlantic-opening geodynamics DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17978934

## What this is (and is not)

Single source of truth & easy door (v30): the canonical narrative is the whitepaper; the no-jargon on-ramp is Start here; every term is in the glossary; the petroleum strand’s single source of truth is the Glaciation-Driven Petroleum overview. This package is v30 (adds the glaciation-driven petroleum strand M33–M44, the Continental-Genesis import M45, the two reframes, a plain-language layer, and one-command reproducibility).

This package presents one question, built out in full and graded honestly:

Is a single coupled relaxation — a flood, a glaciation, and an ocean-opening, all driven by one release of a jammed deep-water reservoir — physically permitted by measured constants and the VP jamming engine?

It is: a unified construction on a single substrate (jammed State-4 water), driven by a single engine (void-suction + unjamming) that is inherited from a separate, reproducible geodynamics volume and re-verified here, presenting as a coupled three-face relaxation with a closing energy ledger and five falsifiable predictions.

It is not: a claim that the sequence occurred; a claim about any absolute timescale; or a comparison against alternative geological frameworks. The last — the "stress-test" — is deliberately deferred to a later phase. This package builds the cascade on its own terms and is explicit about what it does and does not establish.

## Governance (why the grades can be trusted)

The cascade is built under the VP-SPEC constitution, the same discipline as the inherited volumes:

- No-tuning. No parameter is fitted to make a result come out; every number is a measured input or a derived consequence (SEED = 19 convention).

- Graded verdicts. [F] forced/derived · [V] verified (measured / engine-reproduced) · [L] leaning (well-anchored inference) · [O] open. Precedence forced > verified > leaning > open; nothing downstream may launder an [O] into a higher grade.

- Bidirectional chronology firewall. Statements about a past occurrence are capped at [O] in both directions — neither "deep time" nor "recent" is load-bearing. Absolute dates are held as record only. The inherited geodynamics volume concedes the U–Pb break-up ages at full strength and stays chronology-agnostic; the cascade adopts that posture exactly.

- Single substrate. One engine (the R19 jammed ⇄ unjammed bistable switch) underlies every step; the cascade does not introduce a new mechanism per phenomenon.

- Falsification = discovery. An honest negative is a finding, not a failure; corrections are recorded in the open (see the module ledger).

| Fossil-count audit (fossil_audit/fossil_counts.py)
| runs clean (179,689 real dates, counts recomputed from source)

All 8 quantities the cascade inherits from the geodynamics volume (μ_eff ≈ 2.2×10⁻³, φ_jam = 0.840, Ω-NoGo μ_eff ≥ 10⁻², τ_drive ~ 3–32 Pa, τ ≈ 9 s, W_in ~ 3×10²⁶ J, void-suction, unjamming-no-melt) were checked against the source text and match exactly (Module 21).

## How to verify in five minutes

# 0. (optional) third-party deps for the RUNTIME re-runs in steps 4–5
# the core gates (steps 1–3) and repro/verify_all.py need NO third-party libs;
# the DNA re-runs need Biopython + pyreadr, the fossil audit needs pyreadr.
pip install biopython pyreadr --break-system-packages -q

# 1. inherited engine reproduces (39/39)
cd inherited_engine && python3 validate_all.py # tail → "39/39 PASS"

# 2. integrity intact (60/60)
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt | grep -c OK # → 60

# 3. cascade screens run
cd ../repro && python3 c1_quant_screen.py
python3 chain_energy_ledger.py

# 4. DNA Emergence reproduces (inherited whole, runnable for verification)
cd ../dna_emergence/animal/repro && python3 run_all.py # mammoth/elephant + Neanderthal/human
cd ../../plant/repro && python3 run_all.py # cold vs UV, material = lineage property

# 5. fossil-count audit recomputes from the primary database
cd ../../../fossil_audit && pip install pyreadr --break-system-packages -q && python3 fossil_counts.py

Read order: WHITEPAPER.md → REPRODUCIBILITY_MAP.md → modules/ (for the step-by-step governed derivation and every honest correction) → dna_emergence/RUN_DNA_EMERGENCE.md and fossil_audit/README.md for the biology↔history bridge.

## What the integrated package now carries (beyond the cascade)

Per author directive, this package now contains, runnable and graded:

- The DNA Emergence, inherited whole (dna_emergence/). Opening this whitepaper, a reader can actually reproduce the DNA emergence — animal and plant — from frozen NCBI records, no network, no tuning. It establishes three present-tense facts (material is a lineage property; the molecular clock is decoupled from the material; the environment writes to STATE not material) and, by those same facts, shows DNA is neutral on the occurrence: it neither proves deep time nor supports a flood — it exits the elapsed-time question in both directions (Module 22).

- The fossil-count audit (fossil_audit/), an open strand. Raw counts recomputed from 179,689 real radiocarbon dates: ancient remains are genuinely sparse ([V]), but the counts cannot, alone, attribute that sparseness to any cause ([O]). No external model is imported (Module 23).

- Article 7 — audit of interpretation and data (GOVERNANCE.md; Module 24). The standing rule, with its live recorded case: hold every interpretation (including the mainstream one) to its grade symmetrically, and recompute every datum from source rather than recalling it. The willingness to refuse a borrowed explanation and to recompute a number — even against one's own prior output — is itself part of the constitution.

This package establishes a physically-permitted, occurrence-open cascade with a reproducible spine and an honestly-graded ledger — the object its constitution prescribes. It does not claim the sequence happened, and it does not (here) claim superiority over any alternative. Those are separate, pre-registered questions.

# GOVERNANCE — the VP Recent-Sequence cascade constitution

This document fixes the rules the cascade is built under, so any reader can audit it against a stable standard rather than against taste. It is the cascade-level statement of the VP-SPEC discipline inherited from the foundation and the Atlantic-opening volume.

## Article 1 — The question, and the occurrence cap

1.1 The cascade asks only whether a coupled Flood → Glaciation → Atlantic-opening relaxation, driven by one release of a jammed deep-water reservoir, is physically permitted by measured constants and the VP jamming engine.

1.2 — Occurrence cap. Any statement that such a sequence (or any of its faces) occurred in Earth history is capped at grade [O] (open). No chain of reasoning inside the cascade may raise a past-occurrence claim above [O]. Only mechanism and present-tense measurement may be graded higher.

1.3 Whether the sequence occurred is a separate, pre-registered question, decided by independent evidence (notably independent geochronology), not by the construction here.

## Article 2 — The bidirectional chronology firewall

2.1 Absolute chronology (dates, ages, durations) is forbidden as a load-bearing premise in both directions: the cascade neither asserts "deep time" nor smuggles in "recent." Absolute timescales are held as record only.

2.2 The inherited geodynamics volume concedes the U–Pb continental break-up ages at full strength (it does not contest them by inheritance/reservoir/contamination arguments) and stays chronology-agnostic. The cascade adopts this posture without modification.

2.3 The load-bearing case is stated as "a rapid relaxation phase is physically permitted if the bounded boundary conditions obtain," compatible with either timescale — precisely so that the decision is carried by independent dating, not by any internal technicality (e.g. magnetic-stripe patterns, which are degenerate under uniform time rescaling).

v30 note (Art. 1–2, mark-never-erase): present-tense recency is not an occurrence claim. Module 44 reads the deglaciation recency (order 10⁴ yr) from an ongoing, observable fact (rebound is still proceeding now), so it is a present-tense observable graded [V]. The cascade’s occurrence (whether the coupled flood/glaciation/opening happened) remains capped at [O]; the flood/coupling absolute timing is not promoted. Reading “ice recency [V]” as “the flood is proven recent” is a firewall error.

v30 correction ledger: all mark-never-erase corrections of the petroleum/glaciation strand are collected in the Self-audit exhibit (Art. 7 in action): M34 & M37 prior refutations retracted; M38 rock-cycle clock added; M36 ×2 retracted to ~1.2×; M33 all-latitude lock trimmed; M35 timing superseded by M44.

## Article 3 — Data grading (what may be load-bearing)

Observations are tiered by directness; only the top tiers may bear weight.

| Tier
| Meaning
| Load-bearing?

| D0
| raw observation / direct measurement (drilled lithology, recovered phase, seismic geometry)
| yes (ACTIVE)

| D1
| one-step reduction (rate from thickness, modulus from a measured curve)
| yes (ACTIVE)

| D2–D3
| model-light inference from D0/D1
| yes (ACTIVE), flagged

| D4
| model-dependent reconstruction (paleo-reconstruction, chronology-tuned series)
| record only

| D5
| absolute dates / orbital-tuned durations
| record only

A claim may be promoted to [F]/[V] only on D0–D3; D4–D5 inputs are carried as record and never decide a grade.

## Article 4 — No-tuning, single substrate, build-then-grade

4.1 — No-tuning. No parameter is fitted to make a result come out. Every number is a measured input or a derived consequence. SEED = 19 convention; computations are deterministic and scripted.

4.2 — Single substrate. One engine — the R19 jammed ⇄ unjammed bistable switch — underlies every step (substrate S0, the rupture engine, the build/melt asymmetry are the same switch in different settings). The cascade does not introduce a new mechanism per phenomenon.

4.3 — Build-then-grade. The cascade's distinctive geometry is developed first; honest qualifications (openness, degeneracy, holds) are recorded at the end of each step, not used to retreat before the construction is built. A recorded failure mode is premature retreat to a default; the discipline is to build, then grade.

4.4 — Anti-contamination. At each step the cascade checks whether a claim is an unexamined default and strips it — without manufacturing a distinction where none exists. (The systematic comparison to alternative frameworks is the deferred stress-test, conducted separately.)

## Article 5 — Verdict scheme

| Grade
| Meaning

| [F]
| forced / derived — follows from measured constants + the engine

| [V]
| verified — measured directly, or reproduced by a SEED-fixed engine

| [L]
| leaning — a well-anchored inference, not yet forced

| [O]
| open — undecided; includes all past-occurrence claims (Art. 1.2)

Precedence [F] > [V] > [L] > [O]. FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE are contagious: nothing downstream may cite a failed or inconclusive result as support.

## Article 6 — Reproducibility obligation

6.1 Every load-bearing computation is a runnable, SEED-fixed script; every load-bearing observation is a fetchable source. The mapping is given in REPRODUCIBILITY_MAP.md.

6.2 Inherited results are not taken on faith: the inherited engine bundle is re-run (39/39 PASS) and its integrity checked (60/60 SHA-OK) as part of this package, and every inherited quantity is checked against its source (Module 21).

6.3 — Falsification = discovery. An honest negative is a finding. Corrections (e.g. a retracted texture argument, a demoted prediction) are recorded openly in the module ledger, not silently removed.

These rules are fixed for the cascade. A reader who disagrees with a grade can locate the exact article it rests on and the exact script or source that backs it. That auditability — not rhetorical confidence — is the basis on which this package asks to be trusted.

## Article 7 — Audit of interpretation and of data

This article is added after a live demonstration of its necessity during the development of this package's biology↔history bridge. It is binding on every component (cascade, DNA emergence, fossil audit) and on any future strand.

7.0 — The principle. Nothing is load-bearing because someone — an authority, a textbook, a prior model, or this assistant's own memory — says it. Two distinct things must be independently audited before either may be cited:

-
Interpretation must be audited. Any explanatory model is held to its grade and no higher — including the mainstream one. An external interpretation may not be imported to settle the meaning of an observation. A favored interpretation and a disfavored interpretation of the same observation receive the same grade. Symmetry is mandatory: if a flood explanation of a pattern is [O], then a taphonomic or demographic explanation of the same pattern is also [O]. Stripping a disfavored model while quietly installing a favored one as if it were the data is a firewall violation, not an analysis.

-
Data must be audited. A data claim is not accepted from assertion, summary, or recollection. It is recomputed from the primary source: fetch the database, count, and report the raw numbers. "The record is rich / sparse / absent" is an empirical claim that must be backed by an actual count over actual records, not by memory or by citation of a conclusion. Only the recomputed quantity is [V]; descriptions of its shape are [V] only insofar as they describe the recomputed numbers.

7.1 — The recorded case (so the rule is concrete, not abstract). In developing the fossil-count bridge, two errors were made and corrected in the open:

- Data error. The Holocene record was asserted from memory to be "densely documented." This was wrong. The correction was to load a real global radiocarbon database (p3k14c, 179,689 dates) and count: early-Holocene human-remains dates are in fact single dozens per millennium. The original observation that ancient remains are sparse was correct, and the assertion-from-memory was withdrawn.

- Interpretation error. The sparseness was then explained by importing an external model (taphonomic bias) as if it were the settled fact, while the flood interpretation was held [O]. This asymmetry was a violation. The correction was to demote every causal model — taphonomy, demography, flood — to [O], leaving the recomputed counts as the only [V] object, and to route all causal attribution to the history channel.

7.2 — The standing rule. Going forward, every claim in this package is checked on both axes before it is graded: is the interpretation being imported rather than earned? and is the datum recomputed from source rather than recalled? This auditing posture — applied to others' conclusions, to mainstream defaults, and to this assistant's own outputs alike — is itself part of the constitution. The willingness to recompute a number and to refuse a borrowed explanation, symmetrically and without omission, is the discipline on which the grades rest.

7.3 — No exemption for convenience. The rule binds in the direction that is inconvenient as well as the one that is welcome. An external model that supports a desired conclusion is held to [O] exactly as one that opposes it; a remembered "fact" that is flattering to the framework is recomputed exactly as one that is not. The firewall is two-edged by design (Art. 2); Article 7 is the procedure that keeps it so.

Article 7 records why the grades elsewhere in this package can be trusted: not only is each claim mapped to a script or a source, but every interpretation has been checked for being imported, and every datum has been checked for being recalled rather than recomputed. Where that check failed, it is logged here in the open.

- cd fossil_audit && pip install pyreadr --break-system-packages && python3 fossil_counts.py → recomputes the counts from the primary database; confirm raw counts [V] and every cause [O].

- Confirm no causal model (taphonomy/flood/demography) is imported as load-bearing in the fossil audit (Art. 7); confirm DNA carries no occurrence/timescale claim (Module 22).

The bridge is held to the same rule as the cascade: every grade traces to a runnable script or a primary source, every interpretation is audited for being imported, every datum is recomputed rather than recalled, and every occurrence/causation claim is held open and routed to the history channel.

PAGE: GLOSSARY.html
TITLE: Glossary — the terms in plain words | VP Recent-Sequence Cascade

Plain definitions of the recurring vocabulary. The rigorous statements live in Governance; this page is the easy reference.

# Glossary — the terms in plain words

Plain definitions of the recurring vocabulary. The rigorous statements live in Governance; this page is the easy reference.

## The four grades

| Grade | Plain meaning

| [F] forced / derived | It follows necessarily from measured constants and the engine — you cannot avoid it.

| [V] verified | Measured directly today, or reproduced by a fixed-seed program.

| [L] leaning | A well-anchored inference — reasonable, but not yet forced.

| [O] open | Undecided. Includes every claim that something happened in the past — those are open forever, by rule.

Order of strength: F > V > L > O. Nothing downstream may quietly turn an open item into a stronger one.

## The firewall (both directions)

The core rule: calendar dates, ages, durations, and rates are never used as proof — not to argue “old” and not to argue “recent.” They are kept as record only. The firewall is symmetric: it removes the mainstream's dates and withholds the convenient large model numbers, so nothing is inflated in either direction. Only things measurable today (present-tense observables) can carry an argument.

## Present-tense vs occurrence

Present-tense = something you can measure on the Earth now (a rock's layering, a basin's shape, the land still rising). Occurrence = a claim that an event happened in the past. Present-tense facts can be strong ([V]); occurrence claims are capped at [O]. Subtle but important: “the ice melt was recent” is read from an ongoing measurement (the land is rising now), so it is present-tense — it does not mean the flood is proven recent.

## Key terms

| Term | Plain meaning

| R19 bistable switch | The one engine behind everything: a jammed (stuck, load-bearing) state that can flip to unjammed (released, flowing). “Jammed ⇔ unjammed.”

| c² = B/ρ | The VP foundation's core relation (the speed of light as an elastic-wave speed of the vacuum lattice). It is why the deep material can be solid yet flow.

| Dual-redox | Glacial meltwater doing opposite things to oxygen at two depths: sealing it out deep (preserving source rock), bringing it in shallow (making oil heavy).

| Source rock | The organic-rich rock that later generates oil. Needs a quiet, oxygen-starved (anoxic) setting to preserve the organic matter.

| Anoxia / freshwater lid | A layer of fresh (melt) water sitting on heavier seawater stops oxygen from reaching the bottom → the bottom goes oxygen-free (anoxic) → organic matter is preserved.

| Biodegradation | Microbes eating the light parts of oil, leaving it heavy. Happens in cool, shallow reservoirs reached by oxygen-bearing water; shuts off above ~80 °C.

| GIA / forebulge / marine limit | Glacial Isostatic Adjustment: the crust bending under ice and springing back after. The forebulge is the bulge just outside the ice; the marine limit is the highest old shoreline, marking the former load.

| Maxwell time | The time that decides whether a material acts solid or fluid. The mantle is solid over seconds (it carries earthquake S-waves) but flows over millions of years (it convects).

| Stick-slip / duty cycle | Motion that is mostly stuck with rare fast slips. A slow average speed can be rare fast events spread thinly in time — so a present speed cannot, by itself, tell you when it started.

| Conservation identity | On a fixed-size globe, opening one ocean must be balanced by closing somewhere else — an exact bookkeeping fact, true at any speed.

| Double-SHA-256 gate | A self-check inside each program: it hashes its own output twice and refuses to pass unless the hash matches the pinned value — proof the result has not drifted.

| SEED = 19 | The fixed random seed convention, so every computation is deterministic and reproducible.

| Mark-never-erase | Corrections are appended and marked, never silently deleted — so the record shows what changed and why.

| Falsification = discovery | “A refutation is a finding.” An honest negative result is a success, not a failure.

Glossary complete. For the binding statements see Governance; for the easy on-ramp see Start here. Falsification = discovery.

# Open Frontier — single source of truth for remaining tasks

In plain terms. Three different to-do lists had grown up across the package and they no longer agreed with each other. This page is the one authoritative status. It says plainly which questions are now closed, which were advanced (built but waiting on verified data), which are genuinely still open and worth building next, which the author is deliberately holding, and which are open by design — the dating questions the firewall keeps open on purpose, forever, and which are therefore not "to be solved." Where any older list disagrees with this page, this page wins; the older lists are kept unchanged for the record.

One line. After the v30 finalization, the program's frontier is small and precise: the causal-ordering test (Task A) is built and closed (M48), kernel consistency (Task E) is built and closed (M51), the one clean discriminator (SH-26) is protocol-built with its exact verified-data gap pinned (M46/M49), the reservoir bottleneck (SH-5) is localised to a release fraction (M50); what remains genuinely open are the real-geography overlap (Task B), the residual budget closures (Task C), and the SH-26 decisive run (pending verified volumes) — and the two formerly author-held items are now both done (the Tier-4 mainstream stress-test, M52; the B.5 ordering seam, M53). All absolute timing and the one-event coupling question stay [O] by firewall design, both directions — not tasks.

# Irreproducibility Ledger

Constitution C3 requires that anything not deterministically reproducible inside the package be marked [O] with its specific obstacle stated, and that these be consolidated in one place. This is that place. The single most important thing it does is keep two very different kinds of [O] from being confused: a real obstacle that blocks a computation, versus a deliberate epistemic cap that the framework is built to enforce.

Where a harness or protocol already exists, that is stated; nothing here is fabricated to close a gap. These are the only entries that are reproduction obstacles in the C3 sense.

## How to read the [O] badge count

The canonical HTML body currently carries 172 [O] badge instances (alongside 40 [F], 109 [V], 51 [L]). The overwhelming majority are Part B firewall caps — the same occurrence cap restated wherever a past-occurrence statement appears — not Part A obstacles. Only the eight Part A rows above are genuine reproduction obstacles. An auditor should therefore read a high [O] count as evidence of a strict, consistently-applied firewall, not as 172 unsolved computations.

## Canonical-format note

VP-SPEC v1.9 refers to this file as IRREPRODUCIBILITY_LEDGER.md. This package’s Constitution C2 makes HTML the single canonical body, and the spec itself forbids bundling parallel non-canonical sources. The ledger is therefore delivered as IRREPRODUCIBILITY_LEDGER.html so it stays inside the canonical format and is reachable from the same navigation and stylesheet as every other page. This is a deliberate, stated mapping (markdown name → canonical HTML), not an omission. The authoritative remaining-task list it draws from is OPEN_FRONTIER.html; the per-concept [O] entries are mirrored in /concepts/.

PAGE: HTML_AUTHORING_PRINCIPLES.html
TITLE: HTML Authoring Principle | VP Recent-Sequence Cascade

# HTML Authoring Principle

### The stated authoring standard for this package, derived from VP-SPEC v1.8 (Constitution C1–C4). It binds every future edit of the VP Recent-Sequence Cascade.

One line. HTML is the single canonical body; every source subheading is rendered in full; numbers, equations, and grades are invariant; the reproducibility and inherited verification layer stays as-is; open items keep their stated reason; pages are static, semantic, retrieval-ready HTML.

## 1. Canonical single material — HTML (C2)

The HTML files in this package are the single canonical body. No parallel prose
source for the same content ships in the distribution package — no .tex, no .md
body twin. Maintaining one body in two materials causes mutual drift and destroys the reproducibility
baseline, so the prose lives in HTML and nowhere else.

What is not a parallel prose twin, and therefore stays unchanged: reproducibility scripts,
frozen data, computed results, figures, and inherited verification bundles that carry their own
integrity manifests. These are the verification layer, not a second copy of the body.

## 2. Subheading-complete, no abridgement

Each source subheading (#, ##, ###) maps one-to-one to an
HTML heading (h1/h2/h3), and the full text under it is rendered
faithfully. No summarising, no shortening, no fragmentation. Meaning, numbers,
equations, tables, lists, blockquotes, and grades are invariant (LOCK). Corrections mark, never
erase. There is exactly one h1 per page.

## 3. Reproducibility preserved (C1)

Every quantitative claim keeps its in-package reproduction path. The deterministic scripts
(SEED = 19), the frozen primary data, and the double-SHA-256 self-gates are the
verification layer and are not rewritten. The HTML shows the value; the code
regenerates it; the gate proves zero drift. The package integrity manifest
(MANIFEST.sha256) is regenerated by the documented recipe — per-file sha256
plus a SEED-19 double-SHA-256 ROOT-CHAIN over sha256(sha256(file_bytes).digest()).

## 4. Open items keep their reason (C3)

Any [O] or otherwise irreproducible quantity keeps grade
[O] and states its specific obstacle in the body. The grade vocabulary
— [F] forced/derived · [V] verified ·
[L] leaning · [O] open — is preserved
verbatim from the source; precedence is F > V > L > O; nothing
downstream launders an [O] upward.

## 5. Retrieval-readiness (C4)

Pages are static, semantic HTML with no JS-rendered body. Each document opens
answer-first where the source provides a one-line summary; sections are self-contained;
structured data ships in <head> (JSON-LD: ScholarlyArticle +
BreadcrumbList, author ORCID, license, inherited DOIs). URL-layer signals
(canonical, sitemap.xml, robots.txt) are assigned at the
site-merge phase (VP-SPEC §3/§8) and are not fabricated in the handoff package.

## 6. No inline style or script

One shared stylesheet (assets/site.css); no inline CSS or JS; no KaTeX/MathJax span
residue. Inline mathematics is Unicode text (c² = B/ρ); display equations, where present,
are rendered SVG whose alt LaTeX is accessibility metadata — part of the HTML material,
not a separate source.

## 7. Bidirectional chronology firewall preserved

Every past-occurrence statement stays [O] in both
directions; absolute dates are RECORD only; the firewall is symmetric. The conversion never promotes a
firewalled statement and never imports interpretation or dates as load-bearing.

## 8. Link integrity

Internal links to converted files are rewritten .md → .html. Links to
frozen inherited bundles (which remain .md) and all external DOI/URLs are left unchanged,
so the navigation reflects reality: this package's prose is HTML, the inherited verification bundles
are kept in their original form.

## 9. Deterministic, content-faithful conversion

Markdown → HTML is performed by a real parser, never by hand transcription, so numbers and tables
are byte-faithful. The same input yields the same output. The build is recorded so any reviewer can
reproduce the canonical HTML and the regenerated manifest from the package alone.

Falsification = discovery — a refutation is a finding. No-tuning · LOCK → Derive → Gate.

# RECENT-SEQUENCE CASCADE — MASTER SEED / HANDOFF (single-file state)

Author: Young Jae Lee · ORCID 0009-0002-7535-8245 · CC BY 4.0 · https://jamming-physics.org/

Purpose: one self-contained file to resume the work in a fresh session. It carries the thesis, the constitution (firewall rules you MUST apply), the full graded ledger, this session's results, the reproducibility gates, and the remaining tasks. ## 0. HOW TO USE THIS FILE (read §2 before doing anything)

You are continuing an independent research program. Do not default to mainstream consensus, and do not import interpretation or absolute dates as load-bearing. Read §2 (the constitution) first — it is non-negotiable and it overrides the urge to "just answer from training data." §2.5 lists the exact firewall violations that happened in the previous session so you can avoid repeating them.

## 1. IDENTITY & THESIS

v30 reframe (mark-never-erase): two corrections from the petroleum/glaciation strand refine the framing; the prior wording stands, these are appended.

(1) Coupling, not dating. The testable content is causal coupling (present-tense, falsifiable); absolute timing is held [O] by design. This renames the claim — it does not promote occurrence.

(2) Glaciation is the driver (flood secondary). The deglaciation recency (order 10⁴ yr) is present-tense [V] from ongoing rebound (M44). Firewall boundary: this is a present-tense observable about the ice — the cascade’s occurrence stays [O]; the flood/coupling absolute timing is not promoted.

Strand SSOT: Glaciation-Driven Petroleum overview (dual-redox core + 8-fingerprint scorecard).

The cascade is one relaxation of a loaded, metastable state — not five independent claims. The substrate is high-pressure "jammed" water (State-4 / ice-VII), which plays three roles: flood-water source, release latent heat (the ice-age fuel), and collapse of its rigid enclosure triggers the rupture.

S0 LOADED SPRING ........ deep high-pressure water reservoir (jammed/ice-VII)
│ (a shock unjams it)
H-F GREAT FLOOD ......... release → flood + latent-heat WARM OCEAN + cold sky
│ C1: warm ocean + cold sky = rapid snow engine
H-G GREAT ICE AGE ....... continental ice loads; oceans draw down
│ C2: ice mass redistribution triggers the rupture
H-A ATLANTIC EXPANSION .. void-suction / unjamming rupture
│ rupture → warm circulation + mantle heat
S4 TERMINATION ......... ice melts (DOWNSTREAM of H-A); organics buried/heated → petroleum

## 2. THE CONSTITUTION (firewall) — APPLY ALWAYS

Single source of truth: the binding constitution is GOVERNANCE.html. The statement below is retained so this seed stays self-contained; on any conflict, GOVERNANCE governs. v30: present-tense recency (M44) is [V] and is not an occurrence claim — occurrence stays [O] (see GOVERNANCE v30 note).

### 2.1 Grading

- Processing degree D0–D5: D0 = raw observation (top tier). D0–D3 = load-bearing (ACTIVE). D4 (model output) and D5 (absolute chronology) = RECORD, never load-bearing.

- Status grades [F]/[V]/[L]/[O]: [F] = physically permitted/forbidden (screen result) · [V] = observed/verified present-tense · [L] = logical/structural consequence · [O] = open/undecided (and occurrence is capped at [O] forever, Art. 4.2).

### 2.2 The two-edged firewall (Art. 2, Art. 4) — the core rule

- Every past-occurrence statement is [O]. Every absolute date is RECORD, forbidden as load-bearing in BOTH directions.

- The firewall is symmetric: it removes the mainstream's dates AND withholds the convenient large model numbers (so the flood is not inflated either). Halving any RECORD number changes no conclusion.

- The theory's distinctive content reduces, on every axis, to rate / magnitude / timing, which the firewall caps at [O] both ways — so theory and mainstream are degenerate on exactly their core distinction (Module 20). Only present-tense, non-rate observables can be load-bearing.

### 2.3 The audit principle (Module 24) — check interpretation AND datum

- No external interpretation may be imported to settle the meaning of an observation — not authority, not textbook, not a prior model, not your own memory. A favored and a disfavored interpretation of the same observation get the same grade.

- Every datum is recomputed from the primary source, not recalled. Only the recomputed quantity is [V].

- The rule binds the inconvenient direction as well as the welcome one: a model that supports the desired conclusion is held to [O] exactly as one that opposes it.

### 2.4 Reproducibility

- Input-contamination robustness: a sensitivity sweep — not an exhaustive audit — decides whether un-verifiable theory-laden inputs are load-bearing. M35’s forebulge conclusion survives a 315-point contamination hypercube (Te/E/rho_m/nu across their literature ranges), so those inputs need no bottom-audit; the load-bearing claims are dimensionless and never use them. See robustness screen.

- No fitted parameter in any Tier-A object. SEED = 19 convention. Determinism proven by double-SHA-256 self-gates. Changing any LOCK constant defines a new version. Corrections mark, never erase (governance/06).

### 2.5 FAILURE MODES OBSERVED LAST SESSION (do NOT repeat)

These are real firewall breaches the assistant committed and had to withdraw — your most likely traps:

- E2/E6 — importing chronology as load-bearing. Fetching deglaciation dates (Holocene 11.7 ka, Laurentide gone 6.7 ka) and seafloor-spreading rates, then extrapolating them to refute a flood-timing claim. These are D5/RECORD and rate-axis → firewalled BOTH ways. Withdrawn.

- Asymmetric interpretation import. Installing the mainstream "4.2 ka = aridification" reading as if it were the datum while holding the flood reading [O]. Withdrawn.

- Trusting firewalled ¹⁴C ages as accurate. Saying "the mammoth boundary is at ~11,000 BP, so there's no 2300 BC turnover" — that trusts the ages (mainstream reading). The ages are RECORD both ways; you cannot privilege them. Withdrawn.

- Lesson: when a question turns on rate/timing/occurrence or on an absolute date, the honest answer is usually [O], both directions — not a confident refutation built on imported numbers.

## 5. THIS SESSION'S RESULTS (Modules 25–26 + DNA)

- Module 25 — bounded gap window. Flood and Atlantic expansion are not simultaneous: H-A begins ≥100 yr after H-F (author-fixed floor, firm). Non-immediacy is entailed by the finite snow rate (instant loading impossible). Ceiling τ_fuel is finite (keeps the chain "one relaxation") but its number inherits SH-5 = [O]. Floor + load are co-constrained by one engine + one budget. Compatible with the Nile record by construction (relative duration vs. held-out absolute date).

- Module 26 — reading the post-flood record. (a) Contamination arithmetic (firewall-neutral): +7 ka inflation needs ~58% dead carbon; modern carbon drags old samples younger. (b) Raw taxa: bison continuous across 2300 BC (counterexample to universal die-off); mammoth old-cluster; Homo redacted; Elephas 0 (geographic). DB is archaeological → DISCOVERED ≠ EXISTING. (c) Elevation discriminator FAILED: within-region it reverses (Europe/N.America high=older), global match is a Simpson artifact. (d) Reservoir mechanism survives only as a small, sample-specific, non-load-bearing correction [O].

- DNA consolidated. Routes the chronology question entirely to the history channel; DNA and the radiocarbon record agree only that neither can settle the chronology.

### Session 2 — petroleum strand + chain consolidation (Modules 27–31, appended)

- Module 27 — petroleum metastability (oil-cracking clock). Light oil is a present-tense loaded spring: its forward oil→gas cracking lifetime τ(T) follows from measured kinetics, no dates (steep: ~Gyr@90 °C → ~Myr@150 °C → sub-Myr@190 °C). Honest gap: it constrains residence-since-generation, not basin age (recent/continuous charge escapes), so it discriminates only paired with over-mature-source + volume closures → standalone [O].

- Module 28 — source-rock organic budget. Normal oxic burial gives ~0.05 % TOC; real source rocks need several–tens %, which forces three coincident conditions (supply + anoxia + low dilution). Two honest points: "requires a catastrophe" is too strong ([O]), and the dilution paradox (catastrophic mud can dilute organics) inverts the naïve reading. The cascade's real edge is economy — one event supplies all three — [L] (parsimony, not proof). This is the author's biggest idea.

- Module 29 — whole-chain consolidation + weak-link report. Mechanical dependency audit: the scaffolding is acyclic (no circular reasoning); 6 claims unconditionally solid (substrate, flood mechanism, snowfall rate, lab-scale engine, oil metastability, forced source richness); everything else conditional, converging on the reservoir-budget / ocean-heat root, then the glaciation premises, then the rupture-scale premises — all left [O].

- Module 30 — the two internal seams, CLOSED by forced reasoning. The H-A trigger is forced single-valued (the immediate-release reading violates the strictly-positive gap floor) → release primes, glacial load triggers, engine drives; honest cost: near-criticality becomes load-bearing, kept [O] but coherent (a stuck regime, not tuned). The ordering seam closes by one timeline under an explicit checkable condition. The chain is now internally consistent.

- Module 31 — petroleum location on real curated data (Mann, Gahagan & Gordon 2003: 877 giants; Sorkhabi 2009: six intervals > 90 % of oil). Petroleum is strongly non-random: ≈ 66 % of giants in rifting-associated settings (≈ 2× a random null), clustered in a few intervals + salt-bearing rifted margins — the cascade's predicted suite (P1/P4). Honest bounds: co-location alone does not discriminate (mainstream also expects petroleum at rifted margins) → edge = economy [L]; and six relatively-ordered intervals challenge the single-event reading → narrow to one recurring engine-signature or hold [O] (the engine itself untouched).

### Session 3 — archaeology / material-culture horizon (Module 32, appended; answers the ★ task)

- Module 32 — reading the material-culture record across the recent (~2300 BC) horizon. Built under the same firewall: present-tense observables load-bearing [V], every absolute date RECORD both ways, occurrence [O]. Three honest results. (1) Discontinuity is real at every site the author names — Giza-era masonry → cruder 5th–6th-Dyn pyramids → a gap (a measured ×2 height drop, rubble cores in 8/8, the revival building mudbrick cores); a waterlain silt/clay layer capping the late Liangzhu cultural layer; planned Indus urbanism → "maintenance/squatter" occupation; British communal monuments winding down; Skara Brae abandoned — all present-tense (superposition, masonry grade, loss of standardisation), recomputed without dates → [V]. The author's core observation holds. (2) A universal synchronized collapse is contradicted by present-tense continuity in the same record: Middle & Upper Egypt settlement expands, first-intermediate skeletons show no famine/violence signature, the British Early Bronze Age is vigorous, the Luoyang-Basin Longshan keeps thriving, millet is unaffected — the archaeological bison-continuity result of M26. The change that is [V] is selective (loss of centralised monumental/standardised capacity), not a die-off. (3) Cross-site synchrony at a single ~2300 BC instant is [O], both directions: superposition is an order fact local to one site and cannot make two sites simultaneous, and the only other bridge is the absolute-date column — firewalled both ways; the conventionally-assigned dates themselves span ~600 yr (2500→1900 BCE). Plus the "4.2 ka" horizon is drought in Mesopotamia/Egypt but flood/wet in the lower Yangtze, so a single uniform global hydro-event is in tension both ways → [O]. Honest note logged in the open: the Giza masonry decline is a gradual ramp beginning at the 5th Dynasty (it precedes the horizon), which weakens — not supports — a single-instant trigger. The recent-cascade reading survives, routed intact to independent geochronology + the history channel. Three double-SHA-256 gates.

- Module 32 part G (raw-proxy audit, appended). A follow-up audit pressed whether "drought" (used in M32D for the Mesopotamia/Egypt side) is a raw observable or a causal narrative laid over observed inactivity. Tested against the literal primary file — the NOAA/WDS archive of stalagmite GZ14-1, Gol-e-Zard Cave (Carolin+2019), parsed byte-for-byte (raw SHA-256 pinned in-gate; ordering by depth; age RECORD-only). Verdict is split: the rock's Mg/Ca rises ~2.4× over baseline with co-varying δ¹⁸O — a genuine measured observable, so "drought is a pure invented excuse" overshoots → R0 [V]/[F]; but the ladder R1 dust [L] → R2 aridity [O] → R3 "synchronous global cause of the regression" [O] is weak at the top, and the audit's circularity suspicion is mainstream-documented: the authors' own abstract calls a coincident climate event still uncertain and frames it around "settlement abandonment"; a >1000-dataset survey (Nature Comms 2024) finds 4.2 ka is not globally significant and its importance enhanced by the archaeology; the record is two humps not one instant; the Southern Hemisphere reads wet. Net: only R0 is carried [V]; "drought" is load-bearing for neither a flood nor an internal/political reading — cause stays [O] all round (Part D prose corrected, mark-never-erase; SH-50 unchanged and reinforced). Fourth gate. Falsification = discovery.

- The correct contamination discriminator (replaces the failed elevation test): carbonate/hard-water context + aquatic-vs-terrestrial diet (δ¹⁵N) + collagen quality (C:N) — these read the reservoir effect directly. p3k14c lacks these sample-level fields → need sample-level data with context + isotopes + quality. Honest prior: even if real, reservoir caps at ~10²–2×10³ yr; it cannot carry the chronology.

- Faunal question with the right database — a palaeontological ¹⁴C compilation (megafauna last-appearance), read under the same firewall (counts [V], dates RECORD, existence still [O]). p3k14c is archaeological and cannot answer existence.

### D. Open gates (Blueprint Part 3) — HOLD

- Gap-window numeric ceiling (optional) — derive from the "single compressed relaxation" thesis (internal, not imported), else it routes to SH-5. Author's call.

TITLE: Start here — the cascade in plain language | VP Recent-Sequence Cascade

# Start here — the cascade in plain language

This page has no jargon. It is the easy door into the package. Each idea is one short paragraph. When you want the rigorous version with grades, gates, and data, follow the links.

The VP Recent-Sequence Cascade asks one question: could a flood, an ice age, and an ocean opening all be one event — a single release of a deep, high-pressure water reservoir — rather than three unrelated things spread across deep time? It does not claim this happened; it asks whether the physics permits it, and which parts can be checked today.

## The one idea

Deep in the Earth, water can be stored as a high-pressure solid (this is real — it has been found inside diamonds). Think of it as a loaded spring. If it releases, the same release can show three faces: water reaching the surface (a flood), the released heat warming the ocean so it snows heavily and builds ice (an ice age), and the collapse of the reservoir's container helping an ocean basin open. One cause, three faces.

## The rules we hold ourselves to

We never use calendar dates as proof — not “old” and not “recent.” Only things we can measure today carry the argument. When a question really turns on timing, the honest answer is “open,” both ways. Every number is reproducible by a small program that checks itself. And when we get something wrong, we mark the correction; we don't erase it. (The short name for the whole rule set is the firewall; plain definitions are in the glossary.)

## Where the oil comes in

The best-developed part of the cascade is about petroleum. The key insight: the meltwater from the ice age does two opposite things at two depths — deep down it preserves the organic matter that becomes oil's source rock; up shallow it makes the oil heavy. That one idea predicts where the world's oil is and what kind it is, and eight separate present-day checks agree. See the petroleum overview.

## The one thing we can say about timing

Hudson Bay and Scandinavia are still rising today because heavy ice was removed. A slow, springy mantle would already be flat if that happened hundreds of millions of years ago — so the ice melted recently, on the order of ten thousand years. That is a present-day measurement, not a claim that the flood is proven recent (that stays open). See Module 44.

## The one open question

If the ice melt was recent, were the oil source rocks, the salt, and the ocean rifting part of that same recent event — or a separate, much older story? That is the single genuine open question. A companion study of why continents exist (Continental Genesis) lends some of its logic here; see Module 45.

## Where to go next

- The whitepaper — the full unified cascade.

- Petroleum overview — the dual-redox core and the eight-fingerprint scorecard.

- Glossary — every term in plain words.

- Full index — every module and the reproducibility map.

That is the cascade in plain language. Nothing here is a claim that it happened; it is a question about whether the physics permits one coupled event, with the parts that can be checked today checked, and the timing held open both ways. Falsification = discovery.

# Module 12 — Present-Tense Anchors for S0 (Deep High-Pressure Water Reservoir) and H-F (Nile-System High-Energy Hydrological Event)

Author: Young Jae Lee · ORCID 0009-0002-7535-8245 · CC BY 4.0 · https://jamming-physics.org/

Tier: 1 (Recent-Sequence applications branch) · Inherits: Constitution & Blueprint (governance/01), Data Grading Charter (governance/00), Correction Ledger + Mainstream Register (governance/11), Master Scenario (SCENARIO_recent_sequence.md).

Status: EVIDENCE module. Adds present-tense, firewall-admissible anchors to two scenario nodes. No new physics; no chronology imported as load-bearing.

Standing grade: every statement of past occurrence remains [O] (Constitution Art. 4). What this module promotes is physical permission of mechanism (Art. 4.3) and present-tense observation — never historical occurrence.

What this module does, in one line. It replaces two posited scenario inputs — "a deep releasable water reservoir exists (S0)" and "a high-energy hydrological event in the Nile system is physically real (H-F)" — with directly observed, drilled / sampled present-tense data, graded honestly on the processing-degree scale, with the absolute-chronology layer held out as forbidden-as-input in both directions.

## 0. The firewall, restated as the operating rule of this module (the bidirectional razor)

The author's standing directive — do not be swayed by the average theory; every time, suspect whether a claim is the average theory rather than data — has exactly one internally consistent form, and it is Constitution Article 3 (bidirectional contamination guard), not a tilt toward the recent reading:

- Strip the interpreted product. An absolute age ("this is Miocene / ~5.3 Ma") is a product of an attribution + closure model (Art. 2.3). It is named, never computed-on, here — in either direction. The framework does not assert it false; it declines to make it load-bearing.

- Keep the observable. A drilled canyon depth, a salt thickness, an erosion-channel geometry, a spectroscopic water measurement on a physical sample are present-tense measurements (Art. 2.1). These are admissible and load-bearing.

- Do not over-collect the convenient model number either. A model-derived discharge ("68–100 Sv," "largest flood on Earth") is D4 (model output, governance/00) → RECORD, not load-bearing. Leaning on it to inflate H-F would be the mirror image of the error the firewall forbids. It is recorded as context, not used as proof.

- Result-neutrality (Art. 3.3). Where the standard reading is observably supported, that is recorded with equal status. Where a specialist debate is genuinely open (e.g. Mediterranean drawdown amplitude), that openness is reported — it is evidence for the firewall stance, not against it.

This is "confirm the data is raw, then research" executed as governance. The module is therefore honest in both directions by construction: it cannot be read as motivated toward recency, because it load-bears on nothing dated and on no dramatic model number.

## PART 1 — S0 ANCHOR: the deep Earth stores water, and stores it as high-pressure ice

Scenario claim (S0, held [O]). The metastable initial state holds releasable water as State-4 jammed water — high-pressure water that is solid-like even when hot (the scenario's "loaded spring"). [O] evidence needed (per SCENARIO §S0): present-tense evidence that large water reservoirs exist in the crust/mantle, ideally with the high-pressure-ice character the substrate predicts.

Reading (firewall-clean).

- The existence of deep high-pressure water, including water present as ice (ice-VII), is now an observed datum on a physical sample (S0-a, S0-b) — D0/D1, ACTIVE. This is a direct hit on S0's requirement: the scenario's "jammed State-4 water" substrate is not a posited convenience; ice-VII at transition-zone/lower-mantle pressures is a mineral someone has held in a diamond.

- The total water budget of that reservoir is [O] / contested (S0-c, S0-d vs S0-e): estimates span dry to ≳2 oceans, all of them model-derived (RECORD). The reservoir-scale feasibility gate for a flood-scale release (SCENARIO §S1, "reservoir-scale feasibility deferred") therefore remains open — honestly. We have observed that the spring exists and is made of the predicted material; we have not shown the spring is large enough or releasable enough to flood. That is the next quantitative gate, not a result claimed here.

Net: S0's substrate observable is upgraded from posited → observed (D0/D1). S0's magnitude/releasability stays [O]. No chronology used.

## PART 2 — H-F ANCHOR: the Nile system preserves a drilled record of extreme hydrological incision and basin-scale catastrophic flooding, controlled by the Atlantic gateway

Scenario claim (H-F, held [O]). A high-energy hydrological / inundation event ("Flood"), physically permitted on the substrate. The author's specific sub-hypothesis under test here: the Flood is expressed in the Nile river system, and its necessary partner is an Atlantic-expansion / connection event.

Why the Nile system is the right place to look. The Nile preserves, as a present-tense subsurface observable, one of the deepest river-cut canyons known on any continental margin, produced by a base-level collapse that was controlled by the Mediterranean's connection to the Atlantic — and refilled by the largest catastrophic flood known on Earth. The mainstream accepts all three observables; the only layer the firewall removes is the absolute date.

The data now in hand (drilled boreholes + 3-D seismic):

| #
| Observation
| Provenance
